# Discussion Guidelines 💬

Welcome! This is a space for the community to discuss **Space Art Calculator**, ask questions, share ideas, and collaborate.

---

## 📋 Types of Discussions

### 🎯 **Ideas & Suggestions**
Have a feature idea or improvement suggestion? Start a discussion here first before opening an issue.

**Example:** "I think it would be cool to add a preset library for common scenarios..."

### ❓ **Q&A / Help**
Stuck on something? Can't figure out how a feature works? Ask away!

**Example:** "How do I export the simulation data?"

### 🎓 **Show & Tell**
Show us what you've created or learned using this project!

**Example:** "I used Space Art Calculator to teach my physics class about gravity..."

### 🐛 **Troubleshooting**
Having issues? Discuss potential solutions before opening a formal bug report.

**Example:** "The color mixer seems slow on my phone, anyone else?"

### 💼 **General Chat**
Off-topic? Want to chat about related topics like physics, web dev, or accessibility? Use the general category!

---

## 🤝 Community Guidelines

✅ **Please do:**
- Be respectful and constructive
- Search existing discussions before posting duplicates
- Provide clear context and examples
- Help others when you can

❌ **Please don't:**
- Share personal information
- Promote external products or services
- Post spam or off-topic content
- Be dismissive or rude

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

1. **Browse existing discussions** to see what others are talking about
2. **Upvote discussions** you find interesting or helpful
3. **Reply and engage** — your feedback matters!
4. **Start your own discussion** when you have something to share

---

## 📞 Need Immediate Help?

- **Found a bug?** → [Open an Issue](https://github.com/universal-cyber/space-art-calculator/issues/new)
- **Have a feature idea?** → Start a [Discussion](https://github.com/universal-cyber/space-art-calculator/discussions/new/choose)
- **Want to contribute code?** → Check out [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)

---

**Thank you for being part of the community! 🙏**
